scene.title: LRU Cache Eviction Explained
scene.summary: Shows how accessing items moves them to most recent and how inserting beyond capacity evicts the least recently used item.

beats.title: Empty cache
beats.narration: We start with an empty LRU cache of capacity three.

beats.title: Insert A, B, C
beats.narration: Insert three items A, B, C; each new item becomes the most recently used.

beats.title: Access A
beats.narration: Accessing A moves it to the most recent position, shifting others back.

beats.title: Insert D evicts B
beats.narration: Adding D exceeds capacity, so the least recently used item B is evicted and D becomes most recent.

beats.title: Final cache state
beats.narration: The cache now holds C, A, and D with D as the most recent item.
